channel.title: Webflow incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Webflow's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of 503 errors on some hosted sites, Webflow.com, and MCP Server [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of intermittent issues creating new sites and loading the Webflow Canvas [resolved]
item.description:
Some customers intermittently experienced issues creating or duplicating sites, creating or viewing page branches, previewing site backups, or loading the Webflow Canvas between 13:40 and 20:45 UTC today.
We’re no longer seeing customer impact related to this issue, and this incident is now resolved. We appreciate your patience while we worked to resolve this issue.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of issues loading Optimize Dashboard for non-Webflow sites [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. The Optimize management experience for non-Webflow sites is loading normally. Live optimizations running on customer sites were not affected at any point. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of issues with outgoing Webhooks [resolved]
item.description:
Between 3:00 PM PT and 6:35 PM PT, customer-configured outbound webhooks were not being delivered as expected.
This issue has now been resolved, and outbound webhook delivery is operating normally. Any form submissions received during this time were still successfully processed and remain available in the Forms tab within Site settings.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of intermittent errors for hosted sites [resolved]
item.description:
After a period of monitoring, we can confirm our mitigation was successful and site performance has returned to expected levels. This incident is now resolved.
Some hosted pages with CMS content may have experienced intermittent 5xx errors during the following windows each lasting a few minutes (UTC):
- 01:27–01:31 - 01:39–01:41 - 01:51–01:53 - 04:47–04:50 - 05:02–05:03
We appreciate your patience while we worked to investigate and resolve the issue.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of issues logging in to Webflow [resolved]
item.description: This incident is now resolved. Some customers experienced issues logging in to Webflow between 23:30 UTC on July 14 and 00:30 UTC on July 15. We’re no longer seeing customer impact related to this issue. Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve this.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of some missing tooling from the Webflow MCP Server [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting the availability of some Webflow MCP Server tools in the Claude Desktop app and claude.ai has now been resolved. All Webflow MCP tools should now be available in the Claude connector. If you previously experienced missing tools, restarting Claude Desktop or refreshing claude.ai may help ensure the latest tool list is displayed. We’re no longer seeing customer impact related to this issue. Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve it.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of some missing tooling from the Webflow MCP Server [resolved]
item.description:
The Webflow MCP Server is operating as expected, and this incident is now resolved.
If any tools are still missing in the Claude apps, refresh the tool list by following these steps:
1. Go to Settings. 2. Select Connectors. 3. Click the Webflow connector. 4. Click the three-dot menu. 5. Select Refresh tool list.
Thank you for your patience while we worked through this issue.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of 403 errors for some responsive image variants on some hosted sites [resolved]
item.description:
Between 20:22 UTC on July 6 and 08:40 UTC on July 8, a small number of responsive image variants on some hosted sites returned 403 errors on some requests.
This issue was limited to a very small subset of responsive image variants and did not affect all images or all hosted sites. If your site was impacted by this issue, you can restore access to the affected image variants by republishing your site.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience that this issue caused, and appreciate your patience and understanding while we worked to resolve it.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of latency loading some hosted sites and issues provisioning SSL certificates [resolved]
item.description: Between approximately 00:00 UTC and 04:05 UTC, some hosted sites experienced slower loading times and SSL certificates took longer than expected to provision due to an issue with an upstream provider. We're no longer seeing customer impact related to this issue. Following confirmation from our upstream provider and verification by our team, this incident is now resolved. Thank you for your patience while our upstream provider worked to resolve this issue.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of intermittent 500 errors for some hosted sites [resolved]
item.description:
A small number of hosted sites experienced intermittent 500 errors between 20:04 UTC and 20:27 UTC. We identified the cause of the issue and implemented mitigation measures.
We’re no longer seeing customer impact related to this issue, and affected sites have returned to normal operation. This incident is now resolved.
Thank you for your patience while we worked to address this issue.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of issues accessing Webflow services [resolved]
item.description: An issue was identified that impacted access to Webflow services for some customers between 22:45 and 23:20 UTC. Our Engineering team has since mitigated the issue and restored affected services to expected performance levels. We appreciate your patience while we worked to restore service.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of issues accessing Webflow.com [resolved]
item.description:
We’re no longer seeing customer impact related to this issue, and access to Webflow services has returned to normal. Some customers experienced issues accessing Webflow between 15:15 UTC and 15:37 UTC. This incident is now resolved. We appreciate your patience while our team worked to restore normal functionality.
Affected Components: Dashboard → Operational Webflow Canvas → Operational Webflow.com → Operational

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of issues publishing for some customers [resolved]
item.description: Publishing functionality has remained stable following the mitigation work completed earlier, and we’re no longer seeing customer impact related to this issue. Some customers experienced issues publishing between 12:50 UTC and 16:18 UTC on May 18, 2026. This incident is now resolved. We appreciate your patience while our team worked to restore normal functionality.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of intermittent 5xx errors on some hosted sites and issues accessing Webflow services [resolved]
item.description:
This incident that started at 14:15 UTC on April 14th is now resolved. By 16:21 UTC on April 14th, the issue was mitigated for the overwhelming majority of customers (~96%). For a full timeline, details on root cause and action items, you can refer to the following blog post prepared by our CTO, Allan Leinwand: webflow.com/blog/april-14-webflow-incident-report
We know this incident caused serious disruption, and sincerely appreciate your patience while we worked to resolve it.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of issues accessing Webflow [resolved]
item.description:
Between 14:19 and 14:43 UTC, some customers experienced issues accessing Webflow. This has now been resolved, and services are operating normally.
We appreciate your patience while we worked to restore service.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of CSS not loading for a very small number of hosted sites [resolved]
item.description: A small number of hosted sites experienced an issue that affected how styles were published, which may have caused pages to appear without styling. We've identified and fixed this issue and all affected sites should be working as previously expected. We are further investigating to see if any additional action is needed.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of "Refresh required to continue" errors when opening the Webflow Canvas [resolved]
item.description:
We’re no longer seeing customer impact related to this issue, and functionality has returned to normal. This incident is now resolved.
We appreciate your patience while we worked to resolve this issue.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of issues accessing Webflow Canvas via Client Seats [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of issues viewing custom domains in the publishing modal for some customers [resolved]
item.description:
A small number of customers experienced issues where custom domains were not appearing as expected in the publishing modal between Mar 30, 18:00 UTC and Mar 31, 18:30 UTC.
A fix has been implemented, and we’re no longer seeing customer impact related to this issue.
Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve this.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of inconsistent publishing results for some sites [resolved]
item.description: Some sites experienced inconsistent publishing results. During this time, an older version of a site was not always cleared as expected after a new publish. We’re no longer seeing customer impact related to this issue, and this incident is now resolved. Thank you for your patience while we worked through this.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of issues loading the Webflow Canvas and Dashboard [resolved]
item.description: Customers were unable to load Webflow Canvas and the Dashboard between 19:28 and 20:20 UTC. The issue has now been resolved and services are operating normally. Thank you for your patience while we addressed this issue.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of issues with form submission notification emails [resolved]
item.description:
This incident is now resolved.
Between 17:55 and 20:35 UTC (10:55 AM–1:35 PM PT), form submission notification emails were not sent as expected. During this time, form submissions were successfully collected and remain available in the Forms tab within Site settings. However, notification emails that were not sent during this window will not be delivered retroactively.
A fix was deployed, and email delivery has been fully restored. We are no longer seeing customer impact related to this issue.
We appreciate your patience while we worked to resolve this.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of issues purchasing or upgrading plans [resolved]
item.description: Between 07:20 UTC and 12:40 UTC, some customers were unable to complete purchases for new plans due to an issue with one of our upstream providers. They have since identified the root cause and implemented a fix. As a result, new plan purchases are now working as expected again. We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding as we worked to resolve this issue with the support of our upstream provider, and apologize for any inconvenience caused.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Increase in Unexpected 404 Errors on a Small Number of Hosted Sites [resolved]
item.description:
Between 7:25pm and 8:00pm UTC on February 26th, a very small number of hosted sites experienced an increase in unexpected 404 errors when accessing site pages.
Upon being alerted to this issue, our team took action to minimize impact and restore full service to the small number of impacted sites a as soon as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience that this issue caused, and appreciate your patience and understanding while we worked to resolve it.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of form notification emails not being delivered for some customers [resolved]
item.description:
Form notification emails were not delivered as expected between 14:15 and 16:41 UTC due to an issue with an upstream provider. All queued emails from this period have since been successfully processed and delivered.
Form submissions themselves were not impacted and remained accessible via the Forms tab in site settings throughout the incident.
We’re no longer seeing any impact, and this incident is now resolved. Thank you for your patience while we worked to restore normal delivery.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of issues completing payments on some new plan purchases [resolved]
item.description: Between 12:30 UTC and 13:45 UTC, some customers were unable to complete plan purchases due to an issue with an upstream provider. Our upstream provider has identified the root cause and confirmed recovery. As a result, new plan purchases are now working as expected. We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding as we worked to resolve this issue.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of form notification emails not being delivered [resolved]
item.description:
This incident has been resolved. Due to an issue with an upstream provider, Form submission notification emails were not processed as expected between 21:30 February 10th - 21:30 February 11th (UTC). Form submissions received during this time processed as expected, and remain available to review via the Forms tab in Site Settings.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this issue caused, and appreciate your understanding as we worked with our upstream provider to resolve this issue.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of intermittent 500 errors on some hosted sites [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved and services are operating normally. Some sites experienced intermittent errors between 14:32 and 15:01 (UTC). We’re no longer seeing customer impact related to this issue. Thank you for your patience while we worked to address this.

item.title: [RESOLVED] Reports Of Issues Accessing Hosted Sites, Webflow.com, SSL Certificate Provisioning, and Form Submissions [resolved]
item.description:
Following continued monitoring and confirmation from our upstream provider, we’ve verified that performance across all impacted services has returned to normal. This incident is now resolved.
Services were affected between 08:48 and 09:11 UTC. We appreciate your patience and understanding while we worked with our upstream provider to resolve this issue.
